acip: GNYIS PA GANG LA JI LTAR 'BUL BA NI, (DANG BA) STE DAD PA('I SEMS KYIS PHUL DU BYUNG) BA'I MCHOD YUL (ZHING GI MCHOG) SNGAR BSHAD PA LTAR GYI (SKYABS MGON THUGS RJE'I GTER) MDZOD DU GYUR PA'I BLA MA 'KHOR DANG BCAS PA RNAMS (LA DBUL BAR BGYI)'O,,
wylie: gnyis pa gang la ji ltar 'bul ba ni, (dang ba) ste dad pa('i sems kyis phul du byung) ba'i mchod yul (zhing gi mchog) sngar bshad pa ltar gyi (skyabs mgon thugs rje'i gter) mdzod du gyur pa'i bla ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams (la dbul bar bgyi)'o
english: This brings us then to our second point: how we present our offering, and to whom.  I offer all these to that highest karmic object, to the most excellent object of any offering: to my Lama (along with those in His circle), who--as we mentioned before--is a treasure house, a massive storehouse of compassion, my Savior and Protector.  And I do so with thoughts of faith and devotion. The Offering of Our Practice
